# AQI Alarm

> Live air quality for Indian cities, in plain language.

AQI Alarm shows live AQI for Indian cities, helps you check whether you should go out, compare cities, and see the most polluted places right now.
It is for people in India who want a quick, plain-language view of current air quality.

Built by Aditya Pratap: https://adityapratapjhansi.vercel.app/about.html
